```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# This child template expects the following variables in the environment:
# - sig_data: List from compute_signature_data()
# - plot_paths: List of paths to pre-generated plot files

cat(generate_section_header(sig_data))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# ID89 plots: signature and catalog (side by side)
cat('<div style="display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-bottom: 6px;">\n')
cat(paste0(
  '<img src="',
  plot_paths$id89_sig,
  '" style="width: ',
  testfoo,
  ';" />\n'
))
cat(paste0(
  '<img src="',
  plot_paths$id89_catalog,
  '" style="width: ',
  testfoo,
  ';" />\n'
))
cat('</div>\n')
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Decomposition plots (only for non-InsDel15/16)
if (!is.null(plot_paths$id89_reconstructed) && !is.null(plot_paths$id89_diff)) {
  cat('<div style="display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-bottom: 6px;">\n')
  cat(paste0(
    '<img src="',
    plot_paths$id89_reconstructed,
    '" style="width: ',
    testfoo,
    ';" />\n'
  ))
  cat(paste0(
    '<img src="',
    plot_paths$id89_diff,
    '" style="width: ',
    testfoo,
    ';" />\n'
  ))
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# 476-type section header
if (sig_data$has_476_signature) {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<p><strong>Cosine similarity between 476-type signature and the exemplar:</strong> ',
    '<span class="cosine-value">',
    sig_data$cosine476,
    '</span></p>\n\n'
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<div class="signature-note">',
    '476-Type ',
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    ' was not found by de novo extraction. ',
    'This is the 476-Type spectrum of ',
    sig_data$catalog,
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# ID476 signature plot
cat(paste0(
  '<img src="',
  plot_paths$id476_sig,
  '" style="width: 100%; margin-bottom: 6px;" />\n'
))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# ID476 catalog plot (only if signature exists)
if (!is.null(plot_paths$id476_catalog)) {
  cat(paste0(
    '<img src="',
    plot_paths$id476_catalog,
    '" style="width: 100%; margin-bottom: 6px;" />\n'
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

if (sig_data$has_83_signature) {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<div class="subsection-header">',
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    ' corresponds to the 83-type signature <strong>',
    sig_data$ID83signature,
    '</strong>',
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '\n\n<div class="signature-note">',
    'No corresponding 83-type signature found for ',
    sig_data$ID89signature,
    '</div>\n\n'
  ))
}
```

